blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine merchandise exports could breach the $100-billion mark for the first time this year, as booming global demand for semiconductors and electronics continues to drive the country’s shipments to record highs. Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo expressed confidence that exports would sustain their momentum through the remaining months of 2026, and potentially push […]...
